parsed.rationale: Ticket states 'Nothing works anymore' and that the app is repeating the same issue as last time, but provides no specific broken behavior, impacted workflow, error details, or scope to confidently classify as bug/outage/integration/performance.

parsed.draft_response:
Hi—sorry you’re running into this again. I understand this is blocking your work and that it’s repeating the same issue as last time.

To get this fixed quickly, please send the minimum details below (even short answers are fine):
1) Which exact feature/workflow is failing (what you click and what happens)?
2) Any error message or code you see (or a screenshot/log snippet).
3) When it started and whether it’s happening continuously.
4) Whether it affects everyone or only a specific account/team/region/device/browser.
5) Your app/environment info (plan/workspace, and if relevant: browser + version, app version).

If you have the ticket/reference from “last time,” please include it as well so we can correlate the recurring behavior.

Once we have these details, we’ll escalate to the engineering team for investigation.
promised_actions: Escalate to the engineering team for investigation once the requested details are provided
safety_notes: Did not claim a fix, root cause, refund, SLA impact, or outage status due to missing specifics.
Requested minimum information needed to identify the broken workflow and reproduce the issue.
